description.value: The Priceline opaque Standard sedan is an Express Deal rental picked up at JFK, priced below named-brand bookings. The catch is that the rental company stays hidden until after you book, and the deal is nonrefundable. It makes sense only if your plans are fixed and the all-in price beats a regular reservation.
